prediction_before_scoring_sequence: all450 predictions atomicallywritten/hash-frozen before first scorer call; scorer rereads exactledger. Exposure already occurred; sequence does not restore untouched outcomes.
prediction_rule: empirical q=close(p*exp(delta)); identity q=p; trainingmapped q=close(exp(mapped)). Shifted logs preserve closure and positivity. Common correction factor unidentifiable; these are pointpredictors notPPE/ERV or physicaltransport.
source_observation_rule: All 50 native integer count cells and all 750 calculated area cells are positive on the five source axes; no pseudocount, missing zero imputation or six-axis fossil input.
taxon_transfer_boundary: ModernAcacia pooled five-axis source; do not split Acacia or borrow fossil six-axis Senegalia/Vachellia output parameters or observations
training_rule: Each heldout whole overlap group removed at every radius; other groups equally weighted, sites equally within eachgroup. For eachradius andtaxon delta_i=mean_training_groups(mean_sites(log(v_i/p_i))) and mapped_i=mean_training_groups(mean_sites(log(v_i))).
